Standalone actual-package checker verifies multiple finite coefficients and balanced symmetry; finite numerics not used as infinite proof.

value.rationale: The source global center is a natural minimal two-zone quadratic oscillator. High-frequency coordinate data provide a measurable observable beyond its period or shape. An exact rational half-period division changes the decay exponent by three for an infinite frequency sublattice; balancing gives exact even-harmonic silence and irrational ratios give a sharp full limsup/liminf envelope. This identifies a structural, parameter-controlled spectral signature of crossing asymmetry, with independently motivated diagnostic value rather than arbitrary single-coefficient computation.
